values.note: Reserve by phone or the website's contact/reservation-request form; paid in full when booked. 'Reservations may be made at any time up to one year in advance.' Lead-time rule: in the first four months of the year-ahead window only full-week reservations are taken, in the next four at least three or four consecutive days, and single nights only in the last four months (event weekends excepted). Refund in full up to 45 days out, half from 44 to 8 days.

booking.source: https://www.quietoaks.org/policies (Cancellation and Reservations policies) + https://www.quietoaks.org/ ('Give us a call and book your very own getaway today!'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp and added water+sewer (full hookups in the oval/upper area), a campground bathhouse with showers, phone/form booking up to a year ahead with a lead-time-based minimum (kept in booking.note).
